newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs must recover 136.50 to make headway.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs must recover 136.50 to make headway.

text.p: September BTP futures will improve their technical standing if they can recover the 136.50 level, ameliorating the weakness from earlier in the week, technical analysts said on Thursday.

"After recently closing below 136.00, BTPs could be setting themselves up for a further correction," said a technical analyst at a European bank in London. "A close above 136.50 would reduce downside risk, and bring the market back into neutral."
September BTP futures were up 50 basis points at 136.11 by 0800 GMT.

Analysts noted that a double top appeared to be forming on the daily charts, but a close above 136.00 would brighten the outlook. BTPs spiked down earlier in the week, and have not closed above 136.00 since July 14.

"BTPs traded an inside range day yesterday," said a technical analyst at an Italian bank in London in a research note. "A close above (136.00) will negate the double top formation whose downside objective is at 134.85."
He said the major trend was positive, but a further pullback in the short term could not be excluded. Support was pegged at 135.36, the July 15 low ahead of the double top target.
At the short end, September Eurolira futures were up 0.04 at 93.36 by 0835 GMT.
The European bank analyst said 93.20 remains the key technical level on the downside, and the chart needed to overcome 93.45 to avoid the danger of a further breakdown.
September Eurolira set a low of 93.20 on April 4, and this was retested with a low of 93.21 on June 10.
